promise.zh: 让每个产品变化都有清楚的起点、过程和结果，并保持产品界面的克制感。
promise.en: Give every product change a clear start, process, and outcome while preserving a calm interface.

purpose.en: The foundational language used to build motion.

purpose.zh: 把多个原子动效编排成可安装的 React 产品交互。
purpose.en: Installable React interactions composed from motion primitives.

bezel.zh: 页面基底承接环境与留白。
bezel.en: The page bezel carries environment and breathing room.

panel.zh: 抬升面板承接当前任务和可操作内容。
panel.en: A raised panel carries the active task and actionable content.

well.zh: 内凹区域承接输入、预览、代码和局部状态。
well.en: A recessed well carries input, preview, code, and local state.

rule.zh: 使用材质关系表达层级，让边框只负责必要的分隔。
rule.en: Use material relationships to express hierarchy and reserve borders for essential separation.

guidance.zh: 内容抵达时保持短促、方向明确的位移与淡入。
guidance.en: Arriving content uses short, directional travel with an opacity cue.

guidance.zh: 离场节奏略快，让焦点尽快回到下一状态。
guidance.en: Leaving motion resolves slightly faster so focus returns to the next state quickly.

guidance.zh: 按压、选择和数值确认保持紧凑，服务于输入反馈。
guidance.en: Press, selection, and value confirmation stay compact and serve input feedback.

guidance.zh: 进度与连续数值变化使用匀速节奏，避免伪造完成感。
guidance.en: Progress and continuous value changes use a linear rhythm without implying a result that has not arrived.

guidance.zh: 弹性只服务于直接操控后的落点确认，避免用于普通状态提示。
guidance.en: Spring motion is reserved for settling after direct manipulation, keeping routine state feedback restrained.

invariants.zh: 每个状态都预留空间，内容变化不推挤相邻界面。
invariants.en: Every state reserves space so a change does not shove adjacent UI.

invariants.zh: 动效由用户事件或真实系统进度触发。
invariants.en: Motion is triggered by a user event or real system progress.

invariants.zh: 每一段交互都允许中断、重复触发或恢复。
invariants.en: Every interaction can be interrupted, repeated, or recovered.

invariants.zh: 减弱动效保留状态信息与操作路径。
invariants.en: Reduced motion preserves state information and the action path.

invariants.zh: 键盘、指针和触摸获得同等的状态反馈。
invariants.en: Keyboard, pointer, and touch receive equivalent state feedback.

invariants.zh: 优先使用 transform 与 opacity，避免布局属性参与关键帧。
invariants.en: Prefer transform and opacity, keeping layout properties out of keyframes.

rule.zh: 一个瞬间聚焦一个主要视觉角色，辅助角色只负责建立因果和空间关系。
rule.en: One moment focuses on one primary visual actor; auxiliary actors establish cause and spatial context.

rule.zh: React 产品优先使用 Motion 交付；便携场景保留语义 HTML、局部 CSS 和少量 JavaScript。代码与状态图保持同源。
rule.en: Prefer Motion for React products; keep semantic HTML, local CSS, and small JavaScript available for portable delivery. Keep code aligned with the state graph.

description.zh: 把一句产品需求收敛为一组有理由的动效候选。
description.en: Turn a product brief into a reasoned set of motion candidates.

description.zh: 用状态图、角色和节拍组织一段完整产品瞬间。
description.en: Use states, actors, and beats to organise one complete product moment.

description.zh: 产出贴合现有界面的 React + Motion，或按需求交付便携实现。
description.en: Produce React + Motion that fits the interface, or a portable implementation when requested.

description.zh: 检查状态含义、节奏、可中断性、性能和减弱动效。
description.en: Check state meaning, timing, interruption, performance, and reduced motion.

deliverable.zh: 按优先级排序的修改清单

description.zh: 把成熟方案整理为可验证候选，进入公开内容的审核流程。
description.en: Turn a mature solution into a verifiable candidate for the public-content review flow.
